subtitle.message: A little order for your chats

step1.message: Select the checkboxes beside your chats.

step2.message: Use the menu beside Chats to clear, invert or select all.

step3.message: Choose Delete, review and confirm once. Processing runs in the background.

scope.message: Select all and invert affect only chats currently loaded in the sidebar. Scroll to load more. Refreshing clears your selection.

privacy.message: Runs on ChatGPT, Claude and Grok. Only settings are stored; no chats or credentials are saved or sent to third parties.

warning.message: Delete these $N$ chats on $SITE$ using its native deletion behavior. Chat Tidy cannot undo this operation.

failed.message: Completed $N$. The request failed; remaining selections were kept.

stopped.message: Stopped after $N$. Deletions already sent cannot be undone.

refresh.message: Refresh the website after installing or updating.

working.message: Deleting in the background. You can continue using the page.

apiError.message: Check your login or retry later. Refresh to verify uncertain results.

concurrencyHelp.message: ChatGPT / Grok: default 2; not an official limit. Claude uses native batches of 20. Rate limits stop processing.

modeHint.message: When hidden, move to the left edge to reveal.

extensionDescription.message: Select and bulk-delete ChatGPT, Claude and Grok chats from the sidebar. Six languages.

archiveWarning.message: Archive these $N$ chats in ChatGPT. You can restore them from Settings → Data controls → Archived Chats.

archiveWorking.message: Archiving in the background. You can continue using the page.

archiveStopped.message: Stopped after $N$. Archived items can be restored on the website.

coworkArchiveWarning.message: Archive these $N$ Cowork tasks in Claude. Restore them using Claude’s archived task filter. Only Cowork tasks can be archived.

coworkArchiveOnly.message: Claude archive supports Cowork tasks only. Select tasks without ordinary chats.
